Overview

Smederevo is a city in Podunavlje with a population of 64,000. A city on the Danube in eastern Serbia, home to the largest medieval fortress in Serbia and a major steel manufacturing center. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
